Name: Information & Cognitive
Description: Operations targeting perception, cognition, information, or narratives to influence public opinion, decision-making, or social trust.

Name: Economic
Description: Operations affecting financial systems, trade, markets, resources, or the application of sanctions to exert pressure or create dependency.

Name: Political & Diplomatic
Description: Operations targeting governance, institutions, international legitimacy, or diplomatic relations to destabilize or manipulate target states.

Name: Social
Description: Operations targeting the fabric of society, demographics, culture, public order, or internal cohesion.

Name: Military
Description: Kinetic or military capability operations, force projection, and overt or covert military-aligned actions.

Name: Infrastructure & Technology
Description: Operations targeting critical infrastructure (energy, water, healthcare), communication networks, cyber systems, and technological supply chains.
